definitions.explanation: A design or mechanism that allows something to be moved, adjusted, or repositioned.

examples.japanese: {可動式|かどうしき}の{棚|たな}を{設置|せっち}した。
この{橋|はし}は{可動式|かどうしき}で、{大|おお}きな{船|ふね}が{通|とお}れる。
examples.english: This bridge is movable, allowing large ships to pass.

examples.japanese: {可動式|かどうしき}の{間仕切|まじき}りで{部屋|へや}のレイアウトを{自由|じゆう}に{変|か}えられる。
examples.english: You can freely change the room layout with movable partitions.

notes:
Combines {可動|かどう} (movable) with {式|しき} (type; style; model). Used as a noun modifier to describe things designed to be moved, adjusted, or reconfigured. Common in architecture, furniture, engineering, and product descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {可動式|かどうしき}の{棚|たな}: adjustable shelves
- {可動式|かどうしき}の{橋|はし}: movable bridge
- {可動式|かどうしき}の{壁|かべ}: movable wall
- {可動式|かどうしき}の{座席|ざせき}: movable seats
- {可動式|かどうしき}フィギュア: posable figure/action figure

THE SUFFIX {式|しき}:
The suffix {式|しき} indicates a type, style, or method:
- {固定式|こていしき}: fixed type
- {折|お}りたたみ{式|しき}: folding type
- {自動式|じどうしき}: automatic type
- {手動式|しゅどうしき}: manual type

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {固定式|こていしき}: fixed type — the opposite; cannot be moved or adjusted
- {移動式|いどうしき}: portable; mobile — emphasizes the ability to relocate the entire unit, not just adjust parts
